name: Kseniia Shumelchyk
role: Engineering Manager @ Google, Android Developer Relations
bio:
Kseniia is a Developer Relations Engineer on the Android team at Google, helping developers to design and build great apps for Wear OS.

Prior to joining Google, Kseniia worked as a full-time Android engineer and was a Google Developer Expert for Android. Kseniia is a former leader of Women Techmakers Ukraine community and EMEA Google Anita Borg scholar.
